title: Chile's public bodies have until 3 December to join a coordinated cybersecurity purchase of XDR licences
summary: ChileCompra says public agencies can enrol until 3 December in a Coordinated Cybersecurity Purchase run with DIPRES, with ANCI as technical reference. The purchase covers XDR licences for workstations and servers plus installation, configuration, support and maintenance for the contract's duration, according to ChileCompra's notice.
plain: Chilean public bodies can sign up until 3 December to buy XDR security licences together through one coordinated purchase.
exec: Chile is pooling government demand for endpoint detection tooling; agencies must enrol by 3 December.
action: ChileCompra advises agencies to enrol through the Coordinated Purchases application on Mercado Público before 3 December; questions go to comprascoordinadas@chilecompra.cl.
